summary: Synchronized the canonical OpenAPI and mobile/API documentation with the implemented authenticated voice-roster SSE endpoint and required microphone_muted member state. Web and Flutter now reject incomplete roster records instead of silently displaying every participant as muted. Full client tests, Windows CI/Release, local macOS Release and signed ABI-split Android Release builds pass. Physical Android and deployed webhook acceptance remain open.

checks.name: Regression tests before client fix
checks.command: frontend: npm test -- --reporter=dot src/voice/voice_roster_client.spec.ts; desktop: flutter test --no-pub test/voice_roster_api_test.dart
checks.observation: Both new tests reproduced the previous behavior: a roster record lacking microphone_muted was accepted.

checks.name: Flutter complete test suite
checks.observation: All 275 tests pass, including strict REST/SSE roster parsing and updated workspace fixtures.

checks.name: Frontend production build
checks.observation: Typecheck and Vite production build pass; Vite emits the existing informational large LiveKit chunk warning.

checks.name: GitVerse Windows CI
checks.command: Flutter Windows CI run 1688178 for commit 6a8b1ffd9b3a51d4b996873e4c7faac848e1ad6b
checks.observation: The Windows runner completed Flutter tests, analyzer and Windows Release build successfully in 3m10s.

checks.name: macOS Release compile
checks.observation: Built build/macos/Build/Products/Release/BOOHTACORD.app (94.7 MB); runtime, signing and notarization acceptance are not implied.

checks.name: Canonical OpenAPI roster assertions
checks.command: jq -e '.openapi == "3.1.1" and (.paths["/api/v1/voice/rosters/events"].get.operationId == "watchConnectedVoiceParticipants") and (.paths["/api/v1/voice/rosters/events"].get.responses["200"].content["text/event-stream"].schema.type == "string") and (.paths["/api/v1/voice/rosters/events"].get.responses["401"] != null) and (.paths["/api/v1/voice/rosters/events"].get.responses["503"].content["text/plain"].schema.type == "string") and (.paths["/api/v1/voice/rosters/events"].get.responses["500"].content["text/plain"].schema.type == "string") and (.components.schemas.VoiceParticipant.required | index("microphone_muted")) and (.components.schemas.VoiceParticipant.properties.microphone_muted.type == "boolean")' contracts/openapi.yaml
checks.observation: OpenAPI 3.1 JSON parses; watchConnectedVoiceParticipants describes text/event-stream with 401/500/503 outcomes, and VoiceParticipant requires boolean microphone_muted.

checks.name: PowerShell contract verifier
checks.observation: PowerShell Core is not installed. The verifier was updated and equivalent focused JSON/path/field assertions passed with jq.

checks.name: Signed ABI-split Android release build
checks.observation: Release signing was required by Gradle and all three APKs were produced: armeabi-v7a 30.8 MB, arm64-v8a 39.3 MB and x86_64 45.1 MB. Artifacts remain in the ignored local build directory, not git.

checks.name: Android physical acceptance
checks.observation: ADB daemon started but reported no attached devices; no install, login, voice or screen-share runtime check was performed.

remaining: Run the PowerShell contract verifier in an environment with pwsh. Install the generated signed APK on a physical Android device and verify prejoin roster microphone/screen-share status, authenticated SSE refresh, disconnect/reconnect and deployed signed LiveKit webhook behavior. macOS installed-app/session and Windows runtime visual/media acceptance remain governed by the open platform items in the parity checklist.
